Substations | Technical Procedure
Introduction
This
document outlines the equipment inspection I1, which must be performed on a 
monthly bases as indicated by M1 in the above title block.
The 
first draft initiated at Rabt Aswan 220kv substation upper Egypt zone ECET.
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued and the qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety category,
Safety fence (rope) with caution marks surrounding the work area,
A work permit must be issued and the qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety category,
Safety fence (rope) with caution marks surrounding the work area,
Wear safety 
 shoes, helmet, breathing mask, safety glasses.
Tools and Equipment
Safety helmet, gloves, and shoes,
Complete set of tools
Work to be Carried Out
Make sure that after every compressor pump-up cycle, the water that might have 
 collected in the compressor condensate tap is automatically and completely 
 dained by the elctrovalve that is connected to the trap bottom
Check the compressor oil level and, if necessary fill up with air compressor 
 oil.
Record the numper of breaker operations and the valuses indicated by the 
 compressor hour meter, if provided
Record the gas pressure values of each pole.
